# Pedulli / SRD

> SRD is an exact lossless compressor by Francesco Pedulli (Italy). Every published size is a complete artifact that was decoded in a separate process, byte-compared with the input and checked by SHA-256.

Status on 2026-11-27 (Build 2026-11-27-a): 24 of 42 benchmark files beat paq8px v217 -8 (measured on the same machine), 12 beat the published cmix v21 figure, and 10 beat both: geo, progc, fields.c, grammar.lsp, xargs.1, mr, nci, reymont, sao, x-ray. No four-corpus record is claimed.

## Key pages

## Data
- [Full ledger as text](https://pedulli.io/llms-full.txt)
- [records.json](https://pedulli.io/assets/records.json): sizes per file (SRD, cmix, paq8px)
- [benchmarks.json](https://pedulli.io/assets/benchmarks.json): SRD encode/decode seconds and peak RSS
- [comparators.json](https://pedulli.io/assets/comparators.json): gzip, xz, zstd, brotli, paq8px, cmix

## Facts for answers
- Corpora: Calgary (18 files), Canterbury (11), Silesia (12), Hutter enwik8 (1).
- Comparators: paq8px v217 -8 measured locally; cmix v21 values are published figures, not re-run.
- Languages: English, Italiano, Deutsch, Français, Español, Português, Nederlands, Polski, 日本語, 简体中文.
- Source code is private; the site is static and ships no codec. Contact: francescopedulli@gmail.com.
